explanation: The ellipse has parametrization r(t) = (4cos(t), 2sin(t)), 0 ≤ t ≤ 2π, traversed counterclockwise. Thus 2x = 8cos(t) and ds = 2√(3sin²(t)+1) dt, giving option e directly. All displayed integrals also equal zero by cancellation under t → t+π, so they are numerically equivalent; e is the direct parametrized expression.
